name: marketing-winner-analysis
description: Winning static ad analysis, read only: turns an ad account's insights (an uploaded CSV or XLSX export by default, or read-only lookups with a token) into a short list of winning still-image concepts, ranked on conversions and cost together from the raw conversion columns, each preview checked against its row, one slot per concept, with a dated ledger of unused winners, an evidence record per winner, reference images and an optional five-variation brief. Declines every account change. Use when: find my winning static ads, which image ads performed best, analyse an ads export, pick winners to iterate, build a brief from a winning ad. NOT for: pausing, editing or re-budgeting ads (never offered); making the new statics (marketing-branded-graphic); market versions of an ad (marketing-ad-localization); remaking a reference ad (marketing-ad-remake); video ads; brand kits (marketing-brand-kit); measuring media files (media-qc).
